history_policy: This version hash-inherits every v2 timing, input, attribution, and acceptance decision. It adds the existing owned Wasm scalar runner as one versioned family; any later workload, boundary, jobs, checksum, metric, or acceptance change creates another version.
change: Moves wasm_scalar from the explicit deferred inventory into scored rows using the existing byte-identical zig-js/JavaScriptCore source and scalar export. The structural variant reverses JavaScript invocation order while preserving the exact Wasm function, iteration multiset, and checksum.

implemented_families_append.surface: owned scalar WebAssembly i32 arithmetic with module compilation/instantiation inside cold setup and invocation-only warm timing
implemented_families_append.anti_specialization: Base traverses jobs in ascending order; the variant uses a distinct wrapper, identifiers, loop condition, accumulator, and descending order over the identical per-job Wasm inputs. Both call the same scalar export and must retain equal tier attribution.
